name: get_local_variables
description: Get local variables for the shared inspection anchor. If the stopped thread is frameless, a sibling with policy-recognized user frames is preferred, adopted, and disclosed in note. At a breakpoint or step inside a frame the stack display hides as internal (a node_modules dependency), the anchor is that frame — the one the program stopped in — and note says so. A JavaScript frame with no Local/block scope returns empty with guidance instead of mislabeling Global bindings. Responses are size-guarded; pass names:[...] to fetch specific variables in full

includeSpecial.description: Include special/internal variables like this, __proto__, __builtins__, etc. Default: false

names.description: Only return variables with these exact names (case-sensitive). Requested names missing from the scope are listed in the response's notFound.
